toleranceRationale: 0.27 deg is the Sun's angular radius: inside this band the solar disc is partly cut by terrain, and it is also the scale of error expected from 1-degree azimuth bins and 40-120 m DEM cells. Samples inside the band are classified 'uncertain', not visible or obstructed. The same band is applied to Earth.
nearFieldRationale: Terrain closer than 120 m (three 40 m DEM cells) is treated as the landing spot itself, not as horizon. At grazing Sun angles, metre-scale relief inside this distance dominates the horizon on ridge crests, yet the DEM does not resolve it reliably and lander placement controls it. 120 m gave the best agreement with the published LOLA illumination maps (see benchmark).
